raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "A + bedi; bedi (Hindi/Urdu) = without; A- (privative) = not; thus 'not without'",
    "reading": "The negation of lack: abundance, fullness, presence",
    "languages": ["en", "hi", "ur"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Abedi ~ 'à bedi' (French) = to the bed; bed (Old English) = resting place",
    "reading": "A call to repose, to the foundational ground of being",
    "languages": ["fr", "en", "ang"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Abedi from Arabic 'abid' (عابد) = worshipper; suffix -i = adjectival; via Semitic root ʕ-b-d",
    "reading": "One who serves or adores; a devotee in the root sense",
    "languages": ["ar"],
    "source": "Wehr, Hans. A Dictionary of Modern Written Arabic",
    "confidence": 0.8
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Abedi → 'be aid' (be + aid); aid (Old French aide) = help",
    "reading": "To become assistance itself; the self as instrument of succor",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "A-B-E-D-I: Alpha, Beta, Epsilon, Delta, Iota — first letters of Greek alphabet sequence",
    "reading": "The alphabet's beginning and middle; a microcosm of ordered creation",
    "languages": ["grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "A (Aleph) = ox/yoke; B (Beth) = house; E (He) = window; D (Daleth) = door; I (Yod) = hand",
    "reading": "From ox to hand: a path of labor, shelter, revelation, passage, and making",
    "languages": ["he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "A=1, B=2, E=5, D=4, I=9 (A1Z26) → 1+2+5+4+9=21; 21 = 3×7; 3 = trinity, 7 = completion",
    "reading": "A number of sacred completion, thrice seven — wholeness through triune order",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "A + bedi; bedi (Old Norse 'beðr') = prayer; A- (Greek) = without; thus 'without prayer'",
    "reading": "A paradox: the one who prays is also the one who lacks prayer — a mystic void",
    "languages": ["en", "non", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  }
]
